question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Deceive
solution: The correct answer is '**Support**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Deceive**' is '**Support**'. • **Deceive**: to try to make somebody believe something that is not true. (बहकाना, भ्रमित करना) • *Example: He **deceived **his mother into believing that he had earned the money, not stolen it.* • **Support**: to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. [किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना] • *Example: Several large companies are supporting the **project**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Support.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Delude**: to make somebody believe something that is not true. (किसी को भ्रमित करना या भ्रम में रखना) • **Pretend**: to behave in a particular way in order to make other people believe something that is not true. (प्रदर्शन, ढोंग या दिखावा करना) • **Betray**: to give information about somebody/something to an enemy; to make a secret known. (शत्रु को गोपनीय मामलों की जानकारी देना; रहस्‍य उजागर करना) 3a:Tb27, The correct answer is '**Clear**'.
